# QMD Metadata Convention

## Recommended frontmatter
```yaml
---
title: "Code vApp Object Model"
type: object-model
plane: planning
status: active
freshness: recent
provenance:
  - repo-read
  - planning-synthesis
tracks:
  - code-vapp
objects:
  - code-workstream
  - code-session
  - repo-binding
related:
  - ../05-WIKI/OBJECT-REGISTRY.qmd
  - ./CODE-VAPP-CLI-GUI-MIRROR.qmd
---
```

## Recommended fields
- `title`
- `type`
- `plane`
- `status`
- `freshness`
- `provenance`
- `tracks`
- `objects`
- `related`

## Why
If these become consistent, the folder becomes much easier to:
- browse
- render
- query
- transform into a richer graph surface later
